newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: SM Summit shares see active volumes.
newsitem.headline: SM Summit shares see active volumes.

text.p: Investment firm SM Summit Holdings Ltd shares were actively traded for the third consecutive day on Wednesday, possibly on takeover rumours, dealers said.
The company denied it was a takeover target.
The stock, trading around Singapore $0.705, saw more than 6.7 million shares changing hands by 0245 GMT.
Dealers said the keen interest in the stock could be generated by rumours that the company was the takeover target of a Hong Kong party. The takeover price was said to be S$0.85.
A SM Summit spokesman denied the rumours.
"There is no truth to the takeover rumours," general manager Lee Hong Thiam tod Reuters. "Neither is the company aware of any corporate news that could be generating the volumes of late."
